name: Cult of the Dragon Initiate

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Learn Draconic, or another language if you already know it. Magic action: a visible creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or is Frightened of you until your next turn ends; afterwards it's immune for 24 hours. When you make a creature Frightened of you, gain Heroic Inspiration if you lack it, once per Short or Long Rest.

benefits.text: You learn Draconic. If you already know it, you learn another language of your choice instead.
